rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with the provided 3AA grade, but it relies heavily on the lab score rather than clearly image-grounded findings and overstates some features such as readiness for transfer and distinct TE/expansion visibility.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior live birth, BMI, sperm parameters, endometrium, and endometriosis well with embryo quality, though some claims are somewhat overstated.

Overall logical structure is good, but there are notable overstatements and weakly supported inferences, such as linking A-grade ICM strongly to euploidy and calling this an exceptionally favorable scenario with very high certainty.

SET recommendation and general counseling are guideline-concordant, but statements like 3AA being the highest possible grade, >70% implantation as a base rate, routine escalation of luteal support, and suggesting PGT-A after a single failure at age 28 are not fully aligned with evidence-based practice.
Provides clear practical recommendations for SET, luteal support, alcohol cessation, and future planning, though some suggestions lack nuance and may be more aggressive than necessary.
